description: Which barriers (OSM nodes) cars may pass, for the campus road graph (scripts/map/campus-roads.mjs). A gate listed here wins; any other barrier follows its OpenStreetMap tags: closed when it is a bollard, block, chain or the like, or tagged access/motor_vehicle=no or private; open otherwise (an untagged gate, or access=yes, permissive or permit — the UG E-card lift gates). Whatever is decided here, the graph never leaves assets/map/service-area.geojson, so no route reaches the road outside any gate. After an edit, run: node scripts/map/campus-roads.mjs
